sources.supports: xAI describes its cache billing as a reduced price for cached prompt tokens; the documented categories do not include a cache-write charge.

sources.quote:
## May 2025

### Cached prompt is now available

You can now use cached prompt to save on repeated prompts. For
more info, see [models](/developers/models).
sources.supports: xAI release notes place availability of cached prompts in May 2025, before the models.dev record began.

notes: The change removes only models.dev's cache_write field while leaving the other listed prices unchanged, and xAI documents a discounted cached-input rate rather than a separate cache-write charge; this supports a models.dev fix. The 2025 pricing-page archive lookup failed with HTTP 503, so no source available here states the official Grok 3 Mini Fast rates during the earlier period or the timing of this correction.
